name: implementation-planning
description: Turn approved requirements and architecture into minimal executable phases, tasks, and traceability.
---
# Implementation planning

Make phases, milestones, work packages, dependencies, sequencing, safe parallel opportunities, acceptance criteria, and verification checkpoints. Assign `TASK-*` IDs and link each to requirements/ADRs. Critique contradictions and omissions before expanding scope.

Do not implement code or allocate artificial parallel work. Exit with a plan Web App Builder can execute.
